title: Record file read and write
lead: Serialize records to and from the confirmed file format, one file per record.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the store directory, ID allocation, and commands.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
PROJECT.md requires plain-text records that are diffable, mergeable and
reviewable in a PR (Goals 7), and deterministic output (Architecture sketch).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
A serialization module next to the model (paths set by Project scaffolding) and
its tests.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- Round trip: write then read gives an equal record, for every field type the
  model uses (strings, lists, option lists, dates, links).
- Writing the same record twice gives byte-identical output (determinism).
- A malformed file gives a clear error naming the file.
- Under C16 as recommended: the frontmatter is valid TOML read by `tomllib`,
  and the body is Markdown.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Implement read and write for the format the owner confirmed in C16. Under the
recommendation, write a minimal TOML emitter covering only the field types
dlog uses, and read with `tomllib`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes.
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
